title: Lula and Bolsonaro in Near-Deadlocked Race as Brazil Votes in 2026 Presidential Election
detail: Brazil heads to the polls with Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in a near-deadlocked race, according to Japan Times reporting ahead of the final vote count. The tight contest reflects deep polarization in the country entering what analysts describe as a defining election.

title: Ballots Reach Remote Indigenous Communities Ahead of Brazilian Presidential Election
detail: Ballot logistics were confirmed in remote Indigenous communities across Brazil ahead of the 2026 presidential election, ensuring access for some of the country's most isolated voters. Al Jazeera reported on the effort to reach these communities as election day arrives.
